elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2 states that Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable and work product created for Customer.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2 expressly provides that Vendor hereby assigns all right, title, and interest in each Deliverable and work product to Customer.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 14.3 states that Vendor retains Vendor Technology, which Section 1.8 defines to include Vendor's pre-existing software, tools, models, templates, documentation, routines, connectors, and other technology.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Sections 14.3 and 13.2 apply a perpetual licence to Vendor Technology incorporated in or required to use a Deliverable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: Section 13.2 expressly makes the applicable licence irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Section 13.2 expressly makes the applicable licence royalty-free and fully paid.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 14.1 states that, as between the Parties, Customer owns all Customer Data and transfers only a limited processing right to Vendor.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Sections 14.1 and 15.1 limit Vendor to processing Customer Data on Customer's instructions for providing, securing, supporting, and improving the Services for Customer; the defined Services include support, maintenance, corrections, updates, and improvements.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 14.4 provides that no jointly owned intellectual property is created unless the Parties sign a separate instrument. No such instrument is present in the rendered language.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: The Deliverable definition excludes generally applicable ideas, methods, skills, and know-how, while Sections 1.8 and 14.3 preserve Vendor's ownership of Vendor Technology, including tools.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2 gives Customer outright ownership through a present assignment without a time limit, which is broader than a perpetual licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The present assignment of all right, title, and interest in Section 14.2 contains no revocation right or reversion and provides stronger rights than an irrevocable licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2 assigns all right, title, and interest without geographic limitation, providing broader rights than a worldwide licence.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: Customer receives ownership under Section 14.2 without any continuing royalty attached to its exercise of Deliverable rights.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Customer's exclusive ownership and receipt of all right, title, and interest under Section 14.2 include the rights to use and modify Deliverables, without a narrower use restriction.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: As exclusive owner of all right, title, and interest in Deliverables under Section 14.2, Customer may license or sublicense its Deliverable rights.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: Sections 14.1 and 15.1 limit Vendor to processing Customer Data on Customer's instructions for providing, securing, supporting, and improving the Services for Customer; the defined Services include support, maintenance, corrections, updates, and improvements.
